title: Voice-agent turn-taking
summary: Decide whether a transcript fragment signals an interruption.
why: A conversational controller needs a stop-or-continue signal, not prose.

interrupt.instructions: Is the user asking the speaking assistant to stop or yield the turn?

state.transcript: Wait, stop. That is not what I meant.

limitation: Text-only semantic demonstration. Audio VAD, endpointing and production voice latency are not implemented.
